subject.title: Reduce remote node bin probe churn

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this 24-hour success-cache and 1-hour to 24-hour failed-probe backoff policy for remote skill-bin probing, or require a shorter/readiness-aware policy before porting?
rationale: The choice affects startup/reconnect latency, stale remote skill availability, retry recovery, and macOS node exec compatibility; source inspection cannot determine the desired product contract.

options.title: Port With Approved Backoff Policy
options.body: Port the implementation to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, preserve preflight and snapshot invalidation, and require redacted real macOS node proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow Timing Before Port
options.body: Require shorter TTL/backoff or readiness-based invalidation before accepting any replacement branch.

options.title: Close This Branch, Track Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40527 as the canonical product decision and ask for a fresh narrow PR when the policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Port With Approved Backoff Policy
recommendation.body: Port the implementation to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, preserve preflight and snapshot invalidation, and require redacted real macOS node proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across mac node exec policy, system.which probing, and remote skill runtime behavior.
